import json, os, sys, shutil
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-60a/tests/acceptance/W2-60a")
import w2_60a_support as s

BASE = Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"]) / "probe" / "boxes"
SEL = sys.argv[1:] or None


def box(name):
    d = BASE / name
    if d.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(d)
    return s.make_sandbox(d)


def show(tag, run):
    print(f"--- {tag}: exit {run.returncode}")
    print("  stdout:", run.stdout.strip()[-600:])
    print("  stderr:", run.stderr.strip()[-600:])


def gate_files(b):
    m = b.home / ".gov-os" / "machine"
    return sorted(p.name for p in m.iterdir()) if m.is_dir() else []


def temps(b):
    return sorted(p.name for p in b.tmpdir.iterdir() if p.name.startswith("gov-launch-"))


def records(b):
    return sorted(p.name for p in b.records.iterdir()) if b.records.is_dir() else []


def case(name):
    return SEL is None or name in SEL


VENDORED = ("# probe manifest\nversion: \"v6.4.2\"\ntoken_sizes:\n  w260a-vend: 10\n")
VEND_SKILL = "---\nname: w260a-vend\ndescription: a vendored skill with no version\n---\n\n# vend zq-vend\n"
META_SKILL = "---\nname: w260a-meta\ndescription: x\nmetadata:\n  version: 1.2.0\n---\n\n# meta zq-meta\n"

# 1. plan: prints default line, starts nothing, no gate; with Launch by criticality present
if case("plan"):
    b = box("plan")
    crit = "- **Launch by criticality:** C3 model claude-opus-5-5, effort max; C0 model claude-haiku-5-5, effort low"
    text = s.role_text(s.ENGINEER, default=s.default_line(s.SONNET, "high")).replace(
        "- **Tools:**", crit + "\n- **Tools:**")
    p = s.make_project(b, extra={f"{s.ROLES_REL}/engineer.md": text})
    cli = s.install_stand_in_cli(b)
    before = gate_files(b)
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", "--plan", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
    show("plan engineer (with criticality line)", r)
    print("  cli calls:", len(s.calls(cli)), "records:", records(b), "temps:", temps(b),
          "gate files before/after:", before, gate_files(b))
    # gate shut (no gate config): plan still works -> takes no gate
    shutil.rmtree(b.home / ".gov-os")
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", "--plan", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
    show("plan with no gate config", r)
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
    show("launch with no gate config (control)", r)
    # passthrough after -- with plan
    s.plant_open_gate(b)
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", "--plan", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk, "--", "--model", "claude-haiku-4-5")
    show("plan with -- --model other", r)
    # lead role plan, unknown role, closed ticket
    for args in (("orchestrator", s.T.tk), ("lead", s.T.tk), ("cto", s.T.tk), (s.ENGINEER, s.CLOSED.tk),
                 (s.ENGINEER, s.SPEC.tk)):
        r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", "--plan", *args)
        show(f"plan {args}", r)
    # missing and malformed default
    for label, line in (("none", ""), ("malformed", "- **Launch default:** model claude-sonnet-5-5, effort huge"),
                        ("trailing", "- **Launch default:** model claude-sonnet-5-5, effort high; tier C2")):
        s.write_role(p, s.ENGINEER, default=line)
        r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", "--plan", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
        show(f"plan default {label}", r)
    # two default lines
    s.write(s.role_path(p, s.ENGINEER), s.role_text(s.ENGINEER) + s.default_line(s.OPUS, "low") + "\n")
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", "--plan", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
    show("plan two default lines", r)
    # no version line -> plan reads default alone
    s.write_role(p, s.ENGINEER, version="")
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", "--plan", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
    show("plan role with no version line", r)
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
    show("launch role with no version line (control)", r)
    print("  cli calls:", len(s.calls(cli)), "records:", records(b), "temps:", temps(b))

# 2. vendored manifest
if case("vend"):
    for label, manifest, link in (
            ("listed", VENDORED, None),
            ("unlisted", VENDORED.replace("w260a-vend", "other"), None),
            ("absent", None, None),
            ("malformed", "version: [\n", None),
            ("numver", VENDORED.replace('"v6.4.2"', "6.4"), None),
            ("emptylist", "version: \"v6.4.2\"\ntoken_sizes: {}\n", None),
            ("link-outside", VENDORED, "outside")):
        b = box("vend-" + label)
        extra = {f"{s.SKILLS_REL}/w260a-vend/SKILL.md": VEND_SKILL, f"{s.SKILLS_REL}/w260a-meta/SKILL.md": META_SKILL,
                 f"{s.ROLES_REL}/engineer.md": s.role_text(s.ENGINEER, skills=["w260a-vend", "w260a-meta"])}
        rel = "template/governance/kernel/skills/superpowers/vendored.yaml"
        if manifest is not None and link is None:
            extra[rel] = manifest
        p = s.make_project(b, extra=extra, commit=False)
        if link:
            out = b.elsewhere / "vendored.yaml"
            out.write_text(manifest)
            (p / rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (p / rel).symlink_to(out)
        s.git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); s.git(p, "add", "-A"); s.git(p, "commit", "-q", "-m", "x")
        cli = s.install_stand_in_cli(b)
        r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
        show(f"vend {label}", r)
        for name in records(b):
            rec = json.loads((b.records / name).read_text())
            for sk in rec["skills"]:
                if sk["name"] in ("w260a-vend", "w260a-meta"):
                    print("   skill:", sk["name"], sk["version"], sk.get("version_source"), sk["named"],
                          sk["sha256"][:12])

# 3. full launch: appended file, line, settings, record
if case("launch"):
    b = box("launch")
    p = s.make_project(b, extra={f"{s.ROLES_REL}/engineer.md": s.role_text(s.ENGINEER, skills=["w260a-backend"])})
    cli = s.install_stand_in_cli(b)
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk, "--", "-p", "hello", "--effort", "low")
    show("launch engineer -- -p hello --effort low", r)
    calls = [c for c in s.calls(cli) if "--version" not in c["args"]]
    c = calls[-1]
    args = c["args"]
    print("  args (settings elided):", [a if not a.startswith("{") else "<settings>" for a in args])
    st = json.loads(c["settings"][0])
    print("  settings env keys:", sorted(st["env"]), "SUBAGENT:", st["env"].get("CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL"))
    print("  autoMemoryEnabled:", st.get("autoMemoryEnabled"), "compact in env:",
          [k for k in c["env"] if "COMPACT" in k], "--autocompact on line:", "--autocompact" in args)
    print("  sandbox enabled:", st["sandbox"]["enabled"], "filesystem keys:", sorted(st["sandbox"].get("filesystem", {})))
    app = c["appended"]
    print("  appended files:", len(app), "flag positions:", [i for i, a in enumerate(args) if a == "--append-system-prompt-file"], "len", len(args))
    role_bytes = s.role_path(p, s.ENGINEER).read_bytes()
    skill_bytes = (p / s.SKILLS_REL / "w260a-backend/SKILL.md").read_bytes()
    tmpl = (p / ".claude/templates/role-engineer.md").read_bytes()
    want = role_bytes + (b"" if role_bytes.endswith(b"\n") else b"\n") + skill_bytes
    want = (want if want.endswith(b"\n") else want + b"\n") + b"\n" + tmpl
    got = app[0]["text"].encode()
    print("  appended == role+skill+blank+template:", got == want, "name:", Path(app[0]["path"]).name)
    recs = c["records_at_start"][str(b.records)]
    print("  records at start:", list(recs or {}))
    rec = json.loads(list(recs.values())[0])
    print("  record:", {k: rec[k] for k in ("session_id", "model", "model_source", "effort", "effort_source",
                                             "subagent_model", "compaction_threshold", "ticket_class")})
    print("  record keys:", sorted(rec))
    sid = args[args.index("--session-id") + 1]
    print("  session-id matches record:", sid == rec["session_id"], "record file:", list(recs)[0])
    print("  appended_sha256 == file:", rec["appended_sha256"] == app[0]["sha256"])
    for a in (["--model", "claude-opus-5-5"], ["--model", s.DEFAULTS[s.ENGINEER][0]], ["--agent", "x"],
              ["--append-system-prompt", "x"], ["--append-system-prompt-file", "/x"], ["--session-id", "x"],
              ["--autocompact", "5"], ["--settings", "{}"], ["--system-prompt", "x"]):
        r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk, "--", *a)
        print(f"--- launch -- {a}: exit {r.returncode}: {r.stderr.strip()[-220:]}")
    # unwritable record folder
    b.records.chmod(0o500)
    r = s.run_gov(b, p, "launch", s.ENGINEER, s.T.tk)
    show("record folder unwritable", r)
    b.records.chmod(0o700)
    print("  temps left:", temps(b))
